name: HVAC / Home Services

source.readFrom: Grounded in 21 real HVAC website references uploaded to this folder (see the .webp files) plus established home-services conventions.

character: Trust-first HVAC / home-services site built to make the phone ring. Heavy REAL technician & equipment photography, house/hexagon-shaped trust badges, prominent phone number and estimate CTA, service cards, service-area coverage, and Google reviews. Two proven palette directions: (A) NAVY + YELLOW or (B) BLUE + WHITE — both read dependable. Best for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, garage-door and similar local trades.

primary.note: A strong grotesk (Inter / Manrope / Poppins). Headings are heavy (700–800); one hero word is often italic for emphasis. Avoid thin or decorative fonts.

scale.note: Hero value prop; a word may be italic ('Personalized HVAC').
Small label above headings (ABOUT US, SERVICE AREA).

navy-yellow.note: Navy sections + a bright yellow CTA/accent; cream off-white backgrounds. (Reference image 1.)

blue-white.note: Clean blue primary on white, warm-red accent for urgency, dark photo hero. (Reference image 5.)

color.notes: Pick ONE direction to fit the lead's brand. Put the lead's real brand colour in the primary slot; keep a bright/warm accent for CTAs and urgency. Real photography carries the colour more than fills do — keep surfaces calm.

spacing.notes: Roomy ~64–80px sections, white cards with soft shadow, ~1200px column. Uncluttered — trades customers scan fast.

header.note: Sticky. Logo, nav, a bold click-to-call PHONE NUMBER, and a bright 'Get Free Estimate' / 'Book Service' button always visible. Often a service tabs/pills bar (Maintenance · Cooling · Heating · Installation) just under the hero.

fills: 'Call Now' with a phone icon on cards
button.notes: Service cards carry BOTH 'Learn More' and 'Call Now'.

trustBadge.shape: House- or hexagon-shaped badge with an icon.

card.shape: White, soft shadow, rounded; photo or icon on top.
types: service card (photo → title → copy → Learn More + Call Now)

order.layout: Sticky: logo · nav · bold phone number · bright estimate CTA. Optional top strip with hours / rating.

Two proven forms: (A) split — heading (a word italic) + rating + technician photo on the left, and an inline 'Get a Free Estimate' FORM (name, phone, email, zip) on the right; or (B) full-bleed technician photo with dark overlay + heading + 'Book Service'. Both foreground REAL technician photos.
A slim icon tab/pill bar: Maintenance · Renovation · Installation · Cooling · Heating.
A row of 4 house/hexagon badges: years, installs, certified, insured.
'Providing <City> with … Since <year>' — technician photos beside a numbered accordion of differentiators (Family-Owned, Best-Price, Top-Rated).
Heading + a grid/carousel of service cards (photo → title → copy → Learn More + Call Now); often on a navy band.
Alternating text / real-photo rows (Fresh Air, Energy Efficient, Commissioning) — numbered.
A map beside a '<State> Neighborhoods We Proudly Serve' accordion list of towns.
'What Our Customers Say' + Google rating + a carousel of review cards (avatar → stars → quote → name).
'Meet Our Dedicated Team' — a row of technician photos.
'Proud To Partner With The Best' — a row of brand/manufacturer logos (Carrier, Trane, …).
Optional: a 'See us in action' technician video with a play button.
Full-width band: 'Get the Best Heating & Air Conditioning Services' + estimate field/CTA + technician photo.
Logo + social, Company / Services / Contact columns, address, hours, license number; phone repeated.

reusableArchetypes: sticky phone-CTA header + service tabs bar
hero with inline estimate form (or full-bleed technician-photo hero)
service card grid/carousel with Learn More + Call Now
craftNotes: REAL technician / equipment / team photos everywhere — this niche sells on proof, not illustration.
Phone number + estimate CTA visible at all times; service cards add a 'Call Now'.
Trust signals early and often: years, installs, certified, insured, brand-certified, Google rating.
One cool primary (navy or blue) + a bright/warm accent strictly for CTAs and urgency.

referenceImages.note: 21 real HVAC pages are in this folder as .webp (1–21). Generation attaches one as the visual bar; 1.webp (navy+yellow, form-in-hero) and 5.webp (blue+white, photo hero) are the most complete.

reuse: Use for HVAC / plumbing / electrical / roofing / garage-door and similar local trades. Take the sticky phone-CTA header, estimate-form hero (or photo hero), house-shaped trust badges, service cards with Call Now, service-area accordion, review carousel, team + partner logos. Put the lead's brand colour in the primary slot, keep a bright accent for CTAs, and use the lead's REAL photos and their real phone, license, hours and service area from FACTS.
